verdict.rationale: Sonar API provides building blocks (embeddings for RAG, Agent API with sandbox/code execution, structured output, web search tools) that a developer could use to build AI-generated insights over their own data, but it is a raw API/platform, not an end-user product with built-in ingestion or dashboard-style insight generation from 'my data'. missing for 10: native data-ingestion/connectors for a user's own datasets, a first-party UI or workflow that surfaces proactive insights/suggestions from stored user data, and independent evidence of this being used end-to-end for such insights.
